diagnostic_context.problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi‑Fi,
but my phone still works.

llm_answer.root_cause: Windows laptop cached old university password for eduroam Wi‑Fi after password change. Phone uses updated credentials successfully.
troubleshooting_steps: Open Windows Settings > Network & Internet > Wi‑Fi
Select eduroam network and choose Forget to clear cached old credentials
Re‑connect eduroam with your new university username and password
If failure persists confirm university account remains active
llm_answer.note: eduroam Wi‑Fi service is operational; this problem is local Windows credential cache, not campus‑wide outage.
